hooks.prompt: Review the work done in this session. Determine if structural changes were made: (1) New crates/modules added/removed, (2) New directories or major files created/deleted, (3) Public API changed, (4) Architecture or message flow changed, (5) Dependencies added to Cargo.toml, (6) Config schema changed, (7) Build/run instructions changed. If ANY structural change was made AND README.md was NOT updated, you MUST respond with exactly: {"decision":"block","reason":"README.md needs updating to reflect structural changes made this session."}. If no structural changes or README was already updated, respond with exactly: {"decision":"approve"}. Respond ONLY with the JSON object, nothing else.
